title: Internal structures in the category of right-preordered groups
summary: We give explicit axioms for the algebraic theory of the quasivarieties of right-preordered groups and preordered groups. We then look at lattices of effective equivalence relations, which turn out to be similar to the lattices of equivalence relations in the category of groups. Once this is established, we study internal structures in the category of right-preordered groups. We start with some general results and then prove the S-protomodularity of the category of right-preordered groups, when considering the class S of Schreier split epimorphisms.
